name: EmpatheticDialogues
description: A benchmark and dataset of 25k conversations grounded in emotional situations designed to evaluate and train dialogue agents on empathetic open-domain conversation. It measures the ability of models to recognize and respond appropriately to feelings in conversation.
reputation: A well-known empathetic dialogue dataset that has been widely used in dialogue research and as a standard benchmark for empathy-oriented response generation.
notes: Focuses on empathetic responding in dialogue, with human evaluation showing improved empathy over models trained on generic conversation data.
